# Neutral position sensor replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

_No verified summary yet._

## Procedure

1. If a shifter boot ring bolt is seized and breaks off, drill it out with a 5mm, 3/16" or #9 drill.
2. Tap the hole with an M6-1.0 tap.
3. Replace all four bolts with M6-1.0x12mm stainless steel bolts.

_Procedure reported by [t10]._

- 19mm or 3/4" wrench [t10]
- 10mm socket [t10]
